protocol.source_dumps: ood_scores_ta.npz / refpool_ta.npz (dump_ta_scores.py; test seed 99999, 192/192/96 per bin)
protocol.routing: score(x) = energy(x) if snr <= 0 dB else prototype(x)
protocol.tau: 95.0th percentile of known-pool scores (5% FRR operating point; no unknown data used for tau)

variants.A: split-half 50/50 stratified by SNR, stored TA scores
variants.B: headline: prototypes refit on TA held-out reference pool (seed 88888, TA labels), tau calibrated there; energy not calibratable (no logits) — omitted
variants.C: split-half, per-scorer known-ECDF rank normalization; single scorers decision-identical to A
